2014.chapter_name: Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom
2014.question: Answer any two of the following in about 30 words:
2014.prashna: निम्नलिखित में से किन्हीं दो के उत्तर लगभग 30 शब्दों में दें:

sub_questions.1: Write few sentences about the elderly corn merchant.
sub_questions.2: Why did Mr. Johnson think that the narrator did not follow the principle of walking?
sub_questions.3: How did Humayun Kabir define civilization?
sub_questions.4: Do you think that language is crucial to a writer? Give your opinion in short.

anuprashna.1: बुजुर्ग अनाज व्यापारी के बारे में कुछ वाक्य लिखिए।
anuprashna.2: मिस्टर जॉनसन को ऐसा क्यों लगा कि कथावाचक ने पैदल चलने के सिद्धांत का पालन नहीं किया?
anuprashna.3: हुमायूँ कबीर ने सभ्यता को कैसे परिभाषित किया?
anuprashna.4: क्या आपको लगता है कि एक लेखक के लिए भाषा अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण है? संक्षेप में अपनी राय दें।

2021.chapter_name: Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom
2021.context: We must do all we can to prevent conflicts and civil war. Most conflicts happen in poor countries, especially which are badly governed or where power and health are not distributed fairly between tribal and religious groups. So the best way to check fighting is to make a political arrangement in which all groups have their representative. The need is to ensure human rights and economic development of all.
2021.question: OR: Read the following passage and answer the questions that follow:
2021.prashna: अथवा: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:

sub_questions.ii: What should be done to check fighting?
sub_questions.iii: What should be ensured for all?

anuprashna.ii: लड़ाई को रोकने के लिए क्या किया जाना चाहिए?
anuprashna.iii: सभी के लिए क्या सुनिश्चित किया जाना चाहिए?
